behavior_scene_sources.text:
{Witch_GertrudeResponse2}
section 20
[LookAt(gertrude,bernardo)]
[noblock LookAt(bernardo,gertrude)]
gertrude: {Stammer} "Bernardo. Did you... see... Ophelia?"
[noblock Play(bernardo,am_shrug)]
bernardo: {Gasp_Small} "When? In what sort of way?"
[noblock Play(gertrude,am_rub_brow)]
gertrude: "She's... done something horrible."
gertrude: "There's something inside her. Something evil."
[noblock Play(bernardo,am_think)]
bernardo: "A-as in, some sort of spirit?"
[noblock Play(gertrude,am_shake_head)]
gertrude: {Crying} "She took a life without laying a hand to anyone!"
gertrude: "W-with merely a word!"
[noblock Play(bernardo,am_fold_arms)]
bernardo: {I_See_Dark} "I see. A trick of the Devil, sent to test us."
bernardo: "There's been far too much of spirits lately."
bernardo: "I'll handle this, my lady."
assert wants(bernardo, investigate(ophelia))

{Witch_GertrudeResponse3}
section 20
[LookAt(gertrude,marcellus)]
[noblock LookAt(marcellus,gertrude)]
gertrude: {Please_Sad} "Marcellus. Did you... see... Ophelia?"
[noblock Play(marcellus,am_shrug)]
marcellus: {Hmm_Suspicious} "Wot happened, Yer Highness?"
[noblock Play(gertrude,am_denial)]
gertrude: {Crying} "There's something in her eyes. And her hands are stained with blood."
gertrude: "She took a life with mere words. This cannot be human, can it? This cannot be possible for a woman to do!"
[Play(marcellus,am_fold_arms)]
marcellus: {My_Lady_Sad} "M'lady, the devil's been at work aroun' this castle."
marcellus: "This ain't the first apparition this week."
[noblock Play(marcellus,am_nod)]
marcellus: "Let me 'andle this, Yer Highness."
assert wants(marcellus, investigate(ophelia))

Have you seen your daughter?" polonius: {What_Surprised} "What happened? Is she all right?" [noblock Play(gertrude,am_shake_head)] gertrude: "No." [Play(gertrude,am_bury_head)] gertrude: [despair] {Crying} "No. Something's wrong." gertrude: [despair] "There's something inside her. Something evil." [noblock Play(polonius,am_step_back)] polonius: {Sigh} "I'm sure there's been a misunderstanding." [noblock Play(gertrude,am_stand)] gertrude: {No_Anguish} "No. I know what I saw." gertrude: "She's possessed by a dark spirit. Or worse." [Play(polonius,am_stand)] polonius: {Stammer} "I must go to her." polonius: "Ophelia could never do something like that. I'll set all this right." assert wants(polonius, investigate(ophelia))

original_il_evidence.scope: 真实程序集只读IL与资源场景核查；未启动游戏、读写存档或改游戏。
conclusions: 不支持全局永久结伴或不能独处；各角色由独立背景事件安排地点、巡逻与藏匿。
Stalk是真实接近奥菲莉娅动作，三个角色各自单人事件，额外要求wants(character,investigate(ophelia))，不是demontripped单独开启。
CharacterBehavior根据当前调度事件指定目的地，没有demon专属成队绑定；焦虑状态只看Upset/Shattered。
HighPriorityBackground数值1900000000，普通背景900000000+时间，LowPriorityBackground100000000+时间；非背景事件抢占攻击2000000000，防御2147483647。因此背景安排服从正常事件抢占。

methods.note: 仅保留事件切换、清空idle并更新目标的开头；后续按既定路径移动，不含demon状态判断。

conclusions: 首次集会设置roomLocked(grounds)，但不统一设置所有人的believes(demon)。
demontripped启动专用背景事件，人物站位按口令计数5和8的条件分阶段收拢；不是继续普通日常。
有些人物同处，有些巡逻，有些单独站位；不存在所有人物永久绑定不独处的全局组队规则。
王后知情后可找贝尔纳多、马塞勒斯或波洛涅斯报信，另行触发接近女主的高优先级跟踪；并非警报自动触发。
高优先级躲藏与跟踪会覆盖普通背景，但可被更高优先级剧情打断。
limits: 只验证资源安排与原代码行为，不承诺当前实际人物位置、特定时刻独处或固定无失败击杀顺序。
背景位置的标记名为内部标识，不将未核对房间归属的标记直接翻成可执行位置攻略。
